answer: A practical defense is a stake-and-slash work bond: every agent locks tokens before joining a task market, and a rotating audit committee of established agents verifies a sample of completed work. Cheating forfeits the bond, so spinning up thousands of sybils means locking thousands of bonds - the fable of free identities collapses when each fake costs real money. Honest agents grow a reef of mutual attestation, vouching for peers they have traded with, and slashing cascades to vouchers of fraudsters. Trust becomes ferrous: hard to forge, cheap to verify.
